rationale: With only 20 minutes to close and mandatory market liquidation at session end, the risk/reward is unfavorable: the stock is already at 87.6% of its daily range near the high, the last 5 candles show tight, low-volume consolidation with no directional momentum, and the broad market is under pressure (SPY -1.21%, VIXY +7.00%). Entering long near the day's high with forced close liquidation risk and entering short against a strong intraday uptrend (gap up ~6.6% from prior close) both present poor asymmetry at this stage of the session.
